# Davy Keith

## Overview

- **Age:** nine-year-old (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Anne-girl P9](../source/v03-c18.md#nw-v03-c18-p0009)</sub>  
  _previously: 7 (v2)_  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P1](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v3 ch.Change P32](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0032), [v4 CHAPTER 4 THE FIRST BRIDE OF GREEN GABLES P7](../source/v04-c04.md#nw-v04-c04-p0007)</sub>

## Appearance

Davy Keith is a round-headed boy with a snub nose and a crop of fuzzy little yellow ringlets. He has a dimple in one cheek that gives him a comical, lopsided look when he laughs. Over time, he has grown by a whole inch.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)_

## Personality

Davy Keith is a heedless and forgetful boy whose mischievous tendencies are balanced by his reputation as a reformed character. He possesses a lively, inquisitive curiosity that frequently leads him to ask challenging questions about the world around him. Lacking imagination, he takes a practical view of life and aspires to become a storekeeper and live to be a hundred years old.

_Sources: [v2 IX A Question of Color P21](../source/v02-c09.md#nw-v02-c09-p0021), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P30](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0030), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P31](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0031), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P14](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0014), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P30](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0030), +7 more_

## History

Davy Keith moved to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) as a rowdy orphan alongside his twin sister, [Dora](../character/dora.md), to live under the care of [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). During his early months at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Davy frequently caused chaos by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, putting a toad in Marilla's bed, ruining Dora's dress, and locking his sister in a toolhouse. He repeatedly struggled with lying and skipping his prayers, but [Anne](../character/anne.md) consistently counseled him through his confessions and guilt. Despite misbehaving further by spoiling dinner party pies during a visit from a famous author, Davy retained a permanent home at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) after money from his late father's brother provided for the twins' upkeep. Over the years, Davy grew attached to [Anne](../character/anne.md), confiding his jealousies, theological confusions, and moral dilemmas to her, including a night when he confessed to skipping [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing. As [Anne](../character/anne.md) attended college, Davy welcomed her back during her holiday visits, sharing chatter about his schoolwork, lost teeth, and childhood musings. He was present with his family when [Anne](../character/anne.md) married [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) in the [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) orchard, and he later traveled from [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to spend [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) with the newly married couple at their home in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds).

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P6](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0006), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P9](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0009), +956 more_

## Quotes

> "I just did it for fun. Things have been so awful quiet here for so long that I thought it would be fun to give you folks a big scare. It was, too."
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P43](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0043)

> “I never will, now that I know it’s bad,” asseverated Davy between sobs. “If you ever catch me telling a whopper again you can . . .” Davy groped mentally for a suitable penance . . . “you can skin me alive, Anne.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P56](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0056)

> “Why?” queried Davy, settling comfortably down and looking up with a tearstained, investigating face. “Why ain’t whopper as good as falsehood? I want to know. It’s just as big a word.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P58](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0058)

> “Then,” said Davy decidedly, “Marilla is bad, for she tells them. And she’s worse’n me, for I didn’t know it was wrong but she does.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P68](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0068)

> “I’ll do it,” volunteered Davy, “if Marilla’ll hold them by the legs, ’cause I guess it’d take both my hands to manage the axe. It’s awful jolly fun to see them hopping about after their heads are cut off.”
>
> — Davy Keith — [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P21](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0021)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--davy-keith.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) serves as a teacher, household mentor, and boss to Davy. After his mother dies, [Anne](../character/anne.md) helps persuade [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take him in, going on to instruct him against lying, skipping prayers, and playing mischievous pranks. Despite the constant trouble his antics cause, she acts as an affectionate companion and protector, even helping to hide his practical jokes from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

- Student of — teacher helping to bring him up  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0030)</sub>
- Serves under — has the authority to boss him (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Transgressors P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018)</sub>
- Friend of — affectionate household companion and mentor (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Again P14](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0014)</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--davy-keith.md)

[Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) acts as a fond companion and guide to young Davy at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Davy frequently confesses his misdeeds to her, such as hiding his sister [Dora](../character/dora.md) in a toolhouse, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to reprimand him and comfort him through his tears. Before [Anne](../character/anne.md) leaves for college, she spends quiet moments comforting Davy, and he later seeks her help with his studies.

- Friend of — fond companion  <sub>[v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P87](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0087)</sub>

### [Dora](../character/dora.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Dora](../character/dora.md) is Davy's twin sister. Their relationship is characterized by Davy's relentless teasing and rowdy antics, which often target her. Davy forces [Dora](../character/dora.md) to walk along a pigpen fence, pumps water over her to ruin her dress, and on one occasion locks her inside a neighbor's toolhouse, leaving the family to search for her.

- Sibling of — twin brother and sister  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P51](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0051), +8 more</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is Davy's distant relative, guardian, and disciplinarian. She takes Davy into [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) following his mother's death and provides him with a permanent home. While [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) maintains authority over him and reprimands him for his rowdy behavior and falsehoods, she deeply cares for his upbringing and often finds quiet amusement in his mischievous nature.

- Serves under — guardian who gives orders and disciplines him  <sub>[v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v3 ch.Transgressors P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018)</sub>
- Friend of — caring for him at Green Gables  <sub>[v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012)</sub>
- Relative of — guardian taking care of him  <sub>[v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P32](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0032), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P10](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0010)</sub>

### [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--milty-boulter.md)

[Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md) is a peer of Davy's in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) who acts as his rival, specifically competing with Davy over their relative height.

- Rival of — rivalry over height (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Revelation P6](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0006)</sub>
